subject: A jury has viewed CCTV footage of the moment a man dressed in black launched a knife attack on a group of children
posts: Violence against the most vulnerable is the ultimate collapse of the social contract. A jury reviews the footage of a horrific attack on children in Dublin. #Justice #Dublin
The claim here is implicit: that public spaces should be safe for children. The state exists to protect this baseline. Stated Judgement: (0.0, 0.0) — Neutral
The reality is an active, violent extraction of life and safety from the innocent. This is a total failure of the protective function. Resulting Judgement: (-2.0, -2.0) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Delusion.
This act represents a total rejection of human value, forcing a catastrophic decline in the probability mass of a safe future.
The event involves a knife attack on children in Parnell Square, Dublin. The trial is currently reviewing evidence to establish the sequence of this violent event.

The Bright Side:
The swift response of bystanders and emergency services who intervened to prevent further loss of life demonstrates the resilience of the community.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The failure is absolute across all planes. It is a fundamental breach of the WHO (the attacker) and the HOW (the method of violence), rendering the social contract void.

The Trajectory: The Path of Delusion.
When you map the gap between the expectation of a safe society and the reality of this violence...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The active destruction of life forces the probability mass toward a state of total insecurity.

The Unavoidable Truth: Violence against children is an absolute rupture of the human bond.

The Unavoidable Lie: That such acts can be rationalized or integrated into a functioning society.

Alethekanon:
This is a terminal failure of the individual will. The state must ensure that the physical safety of the public is not merely a claim, but a hard, enforced reality.

My heart breaks for the children and families affected by this tragedy. No child should ever know such fear. We must hold each other close and heal together.

There's no 'both sides' here. You attack kids, you've lost your right to be part of the human race. Simple as that. Hope the justice system does its job.
